description_en: Upgrades the minor version of components for a multi-zone instance by calling the UpgradeMultiZoneCluster operation
description_zh: 通过UpgradeMultiZoneCluster接口可以对多可用区实例进行组件的小版本升级
kebab_example: aliyun hbase upgrade-multi-zone-cluster --cluster-id ld-000000000000000 --components LINDORM --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeMultiZoneCluster

parameters.help_en: The ID of the multi-zone instance
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode. If UpgradeInsName is not empty, the mode is forcibly set to single. If UpgradeInsName is empty and RunMode is not specified, the default value is serial. Valid values:

serial: all sub-instances are upgraded.
single: only the specified sub-instance is upgraded
parameters.help_zh:
可选参数，执行模式，如果UpgradeInsName不为空，则强制设置为single模式，如果UpgradeInsName为空且未设置RunMode，默认为serial。可选值
serial 子实例都会升级
single 指定的单个子实例升级
parameters.name: run_mode

parameters.help_en: The name of the sub-instance to upgrade. You can obtain this value from the MultiZoneInstanceModels field in the response of the [DescribeMultiZoneCluster](~~DescribeMultiZoneCluster~~) operation. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, all sub-instances are upgraded
parameters.help_zh: 要升级的子实例的实例名称，可通过DescribeMultiZoneCluster接口里的MultiZoneInstanceModels字段下属性获得，可选参数，不填时子实例全部升级
parameters.name: upgrade_ins_name

parameters.help_en: The component names. You can specify multiple component names separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 组件名称，可传多个，逗号隔开
parameters.name: components

parameters.help_en: The RPM version to upgrade to. If you do not specify this parameter, the components are upgraded to the latest version. If you specify multiple values for Components, you must also specify the same number of values for Versions, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 可选参数，升级到指定rpm的版本，不指定的话升级到最新版，如果Components为多个，要传Versions时也要传多个，英文逗号隔开
parameters.name: versions

parameters.help_en: The names of the components that need to be restarted after the upgrade. You can specify multiple component names separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 可选参数，升级后需要重启的组件名称，多个可用英文逗号分隔
parameters.name: restart_components

UpgradingComponents.description_en: The components that triggered the upgrade among the multiple components to be upgraded
UpgradingComponents.description_zh: 返回要升级的多个组件中触发升级的组件
